accountId.description: Alphanumeric characters generated on the creation of the customer profile.

name.description: Some text assigning a name to the alert.

description.description: Some text describing the purpose of the alert.

iataCarrierCode.description: A two-character code assigned by the IATA to international airlines. Optional unless creating an alert with alertType "Carrier", in which case iataCarrierCode and/or icaoCarrierCode must be supplied.

icaoCarrierCode.description: A three-character code assigned by the ICAO to international airlines. Optional unless creating an alert with alertType "Carrier", in which case iataCarrierCode and/or icaoCarrierCode must be supplied.

flightNumber.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

fromFlight.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

toFlight.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

departureAirport.description: A Three-letter code assigned by the IATA to an airport location representing the departure airport. Optional unless creating an alert with alertType "Port", in which case departureAirport and/or arrivalAirport must be supplied.

arrivalAirport.description: A Three-letter code assigned by the IATA to an airport location representing the arrival airport. Optional unless creating an alert with alertType "Port", in which case departureAirport and/or arrivalAirport must be supplied.

alertType.description: The type of alert being configured. Accepted values are "Global", "Carrier" or "Port".

content.description: If the string "seats, changeindicator" is specified, seat and change indicator data will be included in the alert output.

departureDate.description: A date in the format yyyy-MM-dd for flight departures.

arrivalDate.description: A date in the format yyyy-MM-dd for flight arrivals.

schedules.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of schedules flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to true if you are allowed to use schedules alerts.

status.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of status flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to true if you are allowed to use status alerts.

gaFlights.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of GA flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to false.

unscheduledFlights.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of unscheduled flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to false.

codeshare.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of marketing flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to true.

estimatedArrivalTimeThreshold.description: An integer value +- 1440 minutes. When set a filter match threshold is set to match flights arriving before or after the set threshold. A negative threshold will match flights arriving at or before the ETA time and positive integer will match flights arriving at or after the ETA time. Change Indicator filters take a higher priority to this filter.

estimatedDepartureTimeThreshold.description: An integer value +- 1440 minutes. When set a filter match threshold is set to match flights departing before or after the set threshold. A negative threshold will matchcd flights departing at or before the ETD time and positive integer will match flights departing at or after the ETD time. Change Indicator filters take a higher priority to this filter.

statusChangeFilters.description: Object containing boolean flags for specific change filters.
